thread:
Alice M: kicking off the cross-service deploy for v2.4.1 in the 0200-0300 UTC window. API/runtime/console/router all in the plan, small canary first :white_check_mark:
Ben P: noted. canary target = 1% traffic in us-west, then 10% after 10m if no alerts.
Carla (PlatformEng): console has a schema migration that needs a feature-flag flip. we should delay that flip until router header-split is validated.
Dave SRE: agree. add to rollforward/rollback rules: if router 95th latency > 200ms or error-rate spike > 0.5% in canary, auto-rollback. also watch kv cache evictions during warmup.
deploy-bot: deploy started: api:v2.4.1 -> runtime:v3.8.0 -> router:v1.12.2 -> console:v4.0.0 (canary only). canary target 1% us-west. check ./release-notes/9123 for details.
Alice M: smoke tests to run after canary: basic text gen, streaming path, function-calls hooks, and embed regression suite (short set). please post results in thread.
Ben P: quickheads-up: runtime has a new continuous-batching tweak. performance looks fine in staging, but watch tail-latency for long-context traces.
Carla (PlatformEng): console migration note: 2 DB columns changed. flip sequence: (1) deploy console binary, (2) deploy console-migrations job, (3) enable feature flag. we will keep feature flag off for canary.
Dave SRE: ops checklist: pre-deploy telemetry snapshot taken (baseline), alerting mute removed, incident on-call paged. rollback playbook pinned at /runbooks/deploy-rollback. if datastore write errors > 0.2% revert console migration job.
Alice M: timeline: canary deploy (1%) at T+0, monitoring window 15m. if green, ramp to 10% at T+20, then 50% at T+40, then full at T+60. thumbs from owners required at each step.
Ben P: thumbs on canary from runtime and router owners: :thumbsup:
Carla (PlatformEng): console owner :thumbsup: waiting to enable flag until router header split is on 50% and KV warmup shows <1% eviction.
deploy-bot: canary complete: all containers healthy. metrics: api p95 82ms (baseline 78ms), runtime p95 110ms (baseline 105ms), router p95 95ms (baseline 92ms). no errors above threshold.
Dave SRE: initial telemetry looks within noise. running embed regression now. if any quality regression >2% on eval set, pause ramp.
Alice M: embed regression passed quick-run. moving to 10% now — initiating traffic shift.
Ben P: during 10% ramp, watch GPU utilization and QPS per instance. autoscale policy may need to add 1 extra replica in us-west.
Carla (PlatformEng): router header-split at 10% shows correct routing for console-v4 endpoints. KV evictions down to 0.6% during warmup. still below the 1% threshold.
deploy-bot: traffic shifted to 10%. canary time started at 9123456798.
Dave SRE: running synthetic long-context traces — tail latency stable. continuing monitoring for 20m.
Alice M: decision point: if next 20m stays green, onboard dedicated capacity pin for this release and publish release notes. otherwise rollback to v2.4.0 for API and v3.7.9 for runtime.
Ben P: agreed. I will alert on any new stack-traces referencing batching-kernel.
Carla (PlatformEng): preparing release notes patch: include console migration steps and rollback commands. link: https://internal.redwood/release/9123456789-notes
deploy-bot: ramp to 50% complete. one router pod experienced a transient 502 at T+33 (0.01% of requests). auto-retry handled most, no user impact seen.
Dave SRE: keep an eye on 502s; if >0.1% persist, trigger rollback. currently still below.
Alice M: final check: legal/enterprise customers pinned to dedicated clusters — they will be excluded from canary. verify routing rules before full rollout.
Carla (PlatformEng): verified enterprise exclusion rule is active.
Ben P: all good on runtime. no kernel ooms, cpu steady.
deploy-bot: full rollout started. scheduled post-deploy smoke at 9123456815.
Alice M: great job team. make sure support has the short blurb for status page. tagging on-call for 2hr post-deploy observation.
Dave SRE: putting a 120min watch window. if any of the gating metrics cross thresholds, we execute rollback. otherwise we close and mark release as successful.
Carla (PlatformEng): I'll flip the console feature flag after 30m of full traffic and confirm DB job completed.
Ben P: logging notes: collect a sample trace and KV metrics snapshot for storage.
Alice M: closing thread — leave any late issues here. :rocket:
